description: R0-20-MARKPAID-CONVERGENCE: conformance of the landed R0-PL-04-MARK-PAID-POSTS-LEDGER behaviour (335e1e09, review repairs e9bf3697, merged a53c6206; D-05 default: mark-paid without an amount records the remaining balance) to the R0-20 proof (M27, CF-09). Run from apps/server against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL: npx vitest run test/payments-mark-paid.integration.test.ts test/webhooks.controller.test.ts test/commerce.service.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --reporter=json --outputFile=<report>, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/mark-paid-convergence.json --report <report> (or node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only mark-paid-convergence.json from the repo root). R0-20 claim to case map. RED-BEFORE (c2f6f46d: markInvoicePaid at 719 flipped PAID and wrote a synthetic manual_<id>_<Date.now()> SUCCESSFUL row at 775-787 with no posting): fixed by R0-PL-04 before this packet, so every case below is a regression control; against a temporary revert of that body MP-01..03, MP-05..07, MP-09..17, MP-18, MP-20a, MP-20b and MP-L1 fail. GREEN-AFTER: one SUCCESSFUL payment for the remaining balance through recordPayment with one Payment:<id>:payment_recorded posting and PAID (MP-01, MP-06, MP-07; MP-18 spies recordPayment); after 100 of 250 a 150 balancing payment and a later reconcile keeps PAID (MP-18; 60 of 100 in MP-02); PAID is a no-op (MP-03); two concurrent calls give one payment and one posting (MP-09; races MP-10, MP-11); DRAFT 409 (MP-04); a foreign tenant gets 404 under its own tenant (403 naming A, 403 with no tenant) and the Payment table, read by raw SQL because Payment is outside the tenant extension (M31), holds no row for A's invoice and none in B (MP-19); the same refusals hold on an invoice of A that is already PAID, so the idempotent PAID return (commerce.service.ts markInvoicePaid) can not run ahead of the tenant and membership checks: B gets the unknown-id 404 with no invoice body (MP-19b), and KEY without a tenant gets 403 there too (MP-08b). An injected posting failure rolls back the payment and the status: the payment posting runs before the reconcile inside recordPayment's transaction, so a failure of the posting itself, after its rows were written (MP-20a) or before (MP-20b), strikes before the status is written and those cases show only that it never moved; MP-20c fails the COGS posting step of the in-transaction reconcile, after PAID, paidAt, the payment and its posting were written inside the same transaction, and shows payment, posting and status all rolled back to SENT. The packet text's idempotency key markpaid_<invoiceId> is superseded by the R0-PL-04 review repair ST-PL04-1/ST-PL04-2: the slot is server-built and random, manual_<inv>_markpaid_<hex32>, so no client key, reference or public callback row can capture it (MP-13, MP-14, MP-18); concurrency is serialized by the invoice lock instead. LEDGER: debits equal credits for every transaction of both tenants, reversals included (MP-L2, and per case in expectPostedOnce); deposit-side ledger cash net = sum(SUCCESSFUL) = computeBalance.paid per invoice (MP-18..MP-20b inline, and MP-L1 over every fixture invoice: each case owns its invoice, so its end state is the state after that case). MP-L1 leaves out the refund-bearing fixtures of the R0-PL-04 review (MP-05, MP-12a, MP-12b: M28 refund semantics are V1-29) and the direct-write race and provider stand-ins (MP-10, MP-11, MP-15), which carry no posting by construction. Legacy Stripe caller: the WebhooksController stripe case and the CommerceService markInvoicePaid unit cases stay green; RA-G16-01 and webhooks.controller.ts:86-91 stay deferred (D-05 does not authorize the webhook half). MP-06 pins only that the legacy markInvoicePaid(invoiceId) shape takes the posted path; its deposit account is a KNOWN DEFECT, not conforming (see notes). allowAdditionalCases is true for the MP-12 it.todo (V1-29: settling an invoice after a MANUAL refund), the MP-06 KNOWN DEFECT it.todo (RA-G16-01) and the rest of the two legacy unit files. Fixture prefix k20a_ (registry unchanged).

notes: KNOWN DEFECT (RA-G16-01, deferred; not admitted as conforming): the legacy Stripe webhook shape markInvoicePaid(invoiceId) (webhooks.controller.ts:86) records the receipt as provider 'manual' / method 'MANUAL' (commerce.service.ts markInvoicePaid), so RevenuePostingService.depositSystemKey posts a Stripe checkout receipt Dr CASH / Cr REVENUE instead of Dr PAYMENT_PROCESSOR. Landed by R0-PL-04, not introduced here. MP-06 pins only the posted path and recordedBy null; MP-L1 checks the deposit side as the union CASH | BANK | PAYMENT_PROCESSOR and does not judge which account. The fix needs the caller to name its provider, the webhook half D-05 does not authorize; it is carried as the MP-06 KNOWN DEFECT it.todo in the suite.
